Database CPU hit 98% during batch job last night. Job completed but queries slowed. Summarize and propose next steps.

Summary
Batch job saturated database CPU, degrading query performance until the job completed.

Next steps
- Review batch job schedule and throttle concurrency
- Add read replica or offload batch reads
- Set CPU alerting threshold at 80%

Risks
Left unaddressed, recurrence can cause query timeouts and user-facing errors.

Summary

Next steps

Risks

Memory leak detected in auth service. Pod restarted automatically every 6 hours via liveness probe. Issue started after v2.4 release.

Summary
Memory leak introduced in v2.4 causes auth service pods to restart every 6 hours; liveness probe masks but does not fix the problem.

Next steps
- Profile heap allocation diff between v2.3 and v2.4
- Check for unreleased connections or cached objects added in v2.4
- Consider rolling back v2.4 if profiling is inconclusive

Risks
Continued restarts will cause brief auth outages; leak may worsen under higher load.

Search indexer fell behind by 4 hours after Elasticsearch node was replaced. Caught up after 6 hours. Summarize.

Summary
Node replacement caused a 4-hour indexing lag; the indexer caught up within 6 hours without data loss.

Next steps
- Review indexer retry and backpressure configuration
- Add lag monitoring with alert at 30-minute threshold
- Document node replacement runbook to include indexer drain step

Risks
Search results served stale data during the lag window; users may have acted on outdated information.
